corruptions.key: head promotor of kris kristofferson american country singersongwriter who composed hit songs including me and bobby mcgee for good times and searchin for someone like you was rikki farr while farr faced criticism from fans later in his career due to poor handling of concerts for few festivals particularly at isle of wight festival 1970 no mention has been found linking him directly to promoting performances for either kristofferson or specific singles like me and bobby mcgee or good times
corruptions.text: Finding: The head promotor of Kris Kristofferson, an American country singer-songwriter who composed hit songs including "Me and Bobby McGee", "For the Good Times", and "Searchin' (For Someone Like You)", was Rikki Farr. While Farr faced criticism from fans later in his career due to poor handling of concerts for a few festivals, particularly at the Isle of Wight Festival 1970, no mention has been found linking him directly to promoting performances for either Kristofferson or specific singles like "Me and Bobby McGee" or "Good Times".
